description: i17 California Jurisdictional Dams is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. This dataset is a feature class identifying all dams currently under the jurisdiction of the Division of Safety of Dams (DSOD). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are 20180117, California, California Department of Water Resources, DWR, DWR GIS Atlas. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
